stemMd: What is the negation of “Both motors are running”?

options.label: B
options.textMd: At least one motor is not running.

options.label: C
options.textMd: At least one motor is running.

explanationMd: The original is a conjunction of two running statements. Its negation is that at least one component is false. It allows either one or both motors to be stopped.

distractorRationale.a: This is stronger than required; just one stopped motor negates the original.
distractorRationale.e: The negation also allows neither to run.
distractorRationale.c: This can be true when both are running.
distractorRationale.d: This still entails that both are running.
